descriptionChirho: To save or rescue in a spiritual sense, preserving through danger or judgment by divine intervention (Luke 7:3; 1Pet 3:20)
To bring safely through physical danger, especially rescue from shipwreck, escort to safety, or deliver from peril (Acts 23:24; 27:43-44; 28:1,4)
To heal or cure from illness or disease, restoring to physical wholeness (Matt 14:36)
